launch_gate.note: A >=70GB-free watcher hit is a WAKE-UP TRIGGER ONLY, not authorization to launch. Re-run this gate immediately before EACH launch.
checks_before_each_launch: 1. Re-check free VRAM, GPU util, and ALL foreign processes over MULTIPLE samples (not a single reading).
2. Require headroom BEYOND the planned vLLM budget, incl. room for existing workloads (ragas/Sinsan) to grow.
3. Do NOT assume --gpu-memory-utilization guarantees isolation or prevents OOM; use a conservative budget (~0.70 Kanana / ~0.55 EXAONE) AND confirm absolute free MiB is comfortable.
4. Confirm the selected GPU remains sufficiently available IMMEDIATELY before startup.
5. Keep monitoring during loading, torch.compile, AND inference.
6. Abort + clean up ONLY our kserve-* container if resource pressure develops. NEVER stop ragas or Sinsan.
launch_gate.scope: Kanana and EXAONE may run INDEPENDENTLY on a sufficiently-available single GPU. A.X TP2 stays BLOCKED until BOTH GPUs pass the checks.
launch_gate.reporting: A watcher notification is NOT successful execution. Record ACTUAL smoke-test results (gen/tool/multi-turn/reasoning) BEFORE updating any readiness state. Metrics tagged contended.
